name: @calango/desktop
description: Desktop do Calango: controla o daemon calango local.

scripts.test:main: npm run build:main && node --test test/startup.test.cjs test/a11y.test.cjs test/browser.test.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package:win: npm run build:daemon:win && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:daemon:linux && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && umask 022 && electron-builder --linux --publish never && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs --resources release/linux-unpacked/resources --daemon calango
scripts.build:daemon:mac: node ../../scripts/build-daemon.mjs --goos darwin --goarch amd64 --out bin/darwin-x64/calango && node ../../scripts/build-daemon.mjs --goos darwin --goarch arm64 --out bin/darwin-arm64/calango
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:daemon:mac && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac --publish never && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs --resources release/mac/Calango.app/Contents/Resources && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs --resources release/mac-arm64/Calango.app/Contents/Resources
